scope: Supported sysinfo, original task/mm/host accounting, live task/CPU time, aggregate proc load and idle, shared source/solo ABI and legacy capability boundaries.

architecture.authority: Original proc Source/directory, unique original MemoryReport identities and original host callback; no task-table copy or owner statistics RPC.
architecture.execution: Calling executor; actual destination preflight precedes provider/host sampling. Missing actual statistics/host providers preserve explicit legacy deferral.
architecture.accounting: One relaxed packed time word per original task/CPU slot; begin/finish only at existing assignment/scoped/solo boundaries using existing timestamps. Cold publication cannot overwrite a running interval.
architecture.load: One original shared load object. Aggregate observers advance the existing five-second exponential sample from current runnable state. No unobserved history is reconstructed.
architecture.idle: Elapsed configured CPU capacity minus original live execution-slot time, saturating at zero.
architecture.memory: Untouched mappings consume no residency. Finite limits deduplicate shared live mm reports. Host-managed sysinfo directly samples original host memory and omits irrelevant residency scans.
no_new: ordinary guest memory check or fence

limits: CPU time retains approximate wall-assignment accounting, not precise host thread CPU time.
Load remains observer-sampled approximation; no periodic history is collected between actual observations.
Packed nanosecond total/offset range is approximately 73 years.
Concurrent membership/residency/time fields are approximate resource observations, not one global transaction.
No Firefox/Geekbench/general throughput speedup or complete coordinator removal is claimed.
regressions: Full 112-byte destination preflight before provider deferral or host samples; original EFAULT and no partial invalid writes.
Original ABI fixed-point loads, task field width, zero padding and mem_unit.
Original mm residency deduplication across CLONE_VM, untouched VA, original task exit and final weak directory lifetime.
Original host reports change live; absence remains explicit; proc and sysinfo agree on host memory.
Live time sampled before assignment returns, original CPU migration, cold publication and load decay.
Source sysinfo with 4/12 logical CPUs and one physical slot: one cohort, no returned sysinfo or service requests.
Valid provider-less legacy call still returns its original explicit boundary; invalid destination finishes locally.
Seccomp ALLOW/ERRNO and destination faults: exactly one decision per entry.
